name: FreePresenter
shortDescription: A free presentation application for churches with live search, multiple outputs, layouts, NDI, service planning and media tools.
suitableContexts: Teams that need flexible multi-output presentation
Churches willing to assess a newer free application

pricing.summary: FreePresenter is published as a free presentation app. The supplier says full cloud support is still under development and will be an opt-in subscription feature, with no current price shown.

tiers.label: Desktop application
tiers.detail: Supplier describes the presentation app as free

tiers.label: Future full cloud support
tiers.detail: Supplier says this will be opt-in and subscription based when available

editorial.assessment: FreePresenter offers an interesting live-output-first design for worship teams, with a published free desktop model. Because the product and its future cloud option are evolving, a church should test it under its own service conditions and not assume feature or support commitments beyond what is live today.
bestFor: Production teams needing multiple distinct outputs
Churches ready to test an evolving free presentation application
strengths: Supplier lists NDI, DeckLink and multi-output layout support
limitations: Cloud support and its future pricing are not yet published
UK content licensing and operational support are not confirmed

longForm.verdict: FreePresenter is most appealing for teams that need to adapt outputs live rather than prepare a fixed slide deck. It should be tested on the church’s actual screens and streaming setup before it becomes a Sunday dependency.

decisionLens.heading: Verify the output path end to end.
decisionLens.text: Multiple outputs, NDI and DeckLink matter only if they work with the church’s particular projector, stage display, stream and network. Test both the desired layout and failure recovery with the operator who will normally run it.

sections.heading: Layouts and live outputs
sections.question: Does the output-first approach fit the service team?
paragraphs: FreePresenter describes live Bible and song search, layouts rather than traditional slides, multiple outputs, NDI, DeckLink, service planning and calendar functions. It says its desktop application is free.

Build one genuine service and send different content to the congregation display, stage and stream. Check performance, volunteer learning time and the practical availability of the Bible and song material the church is licensed to use.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not use an independent review score. It is based on FreePresenter’s official product and documentation pages.
themes: The live-output model should be tested against the actual AV workflow.
Future cloud functionality should not be assumed to be free or available now.
userFeedback.caveat: Supplier claims are not independent testing, and feature descriptions do not establish suitability for a particular church’s hardware or licences.

faq.question: Is FreePresenter free?
faq.answer: Yes. The supplier presents the desktop application as free to use.

faq.question: Does FreePresenter offer a trial?
faq.answer: No trial is needed for the free desktop app.

faq.question: Will FreePresenter’s cloud features be free?
faq.answer: Not according to the current supplier description. It says full cloud support is under development and will be an opt-in subscription feature, with price not yet published.
